summary: Shelf Ledger: A personal home-library tracker that records every book you own, who currently has it on loan, and gives a quick at-a-glance count of what's out.
implemented_features: Add a book to the collection
See how many are lent out
assumptions: Built for A single user managing their own book collection on their own computer..
Persistence decision: Browser localStorage under key 'shelf-ledger-books'; load with malformed-data recovery that falls back to an empty array.
